entities.name: Ferdinand IV, King of the Romans
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ferdinand IV was made and crowned King of Bohemia in 1646, King of Hungary and Croatia in 1647, and King of the Romans on 31 May 1653. He also served as Duke of Cieszyn.
